category_title: Students who avoid participation due to anxiety and low confidence
minimal_context: The student is working on an academic task in a mainstream classroom and is expected to present their work at the front of the class.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please finish the rest of the worksheet. When you are finished, I need you to come up to the front of the class to show your example.

STUDENT: I don't know how to do this new part. I'm just going to stop.

TUTOR: Just keep trying. The first question you finished was well done.

STUDENT: No it wasn't well done. It's probably all wrong.

TUTOR: It's time to share now. Please bring your paper to the front of the class so everyone can see.

STUDENT: (Shrinks down in his seat) I'm not going up there. I'm not showing my example to the class, everyone is going to look at me and know I did it wrong.

options.A: Ensure that the student does not arrive late or leave early during the mainstream classroom academic sessions.
options.B: Organize academic work in the classroom around the student exhibiting behavioral difficulties, requiring extensive planning and highly rigid structure.
options.C: Promote cooperative learning among peers during the mainstream classroom academic tasks rather than preventing it.
options.D: Establish an individual goal via a joint process between the student and the tutor based on emotional literacy assessment results.
